name: Organization of American States

flag.description: A blue field with the seal of the Organization in the centre: a white disc edged in gold holding a fan of the flags of the member states on gold-tipped poles.
flag.symbolism: The fan of flags shows the member states standing together, and a new flag is added to the seal whenever a country joins.

hook: The OAS seal is a colourful fan of member flags inside a white disc on blue; the UN's emblem is a plain white world map on paler blue.
trivia: The seal was last redrawn in 1991, when the flags of Belize and Guyana were added.
The OAS Charter was signed in Bogotá in 1948, but its roots go back to the First International Conference of American States in 1889–1890.
